memoryRule: a travelled reading return exchanges two actual word places and rewrites a non-local reply; later returns choose a different partner through remembered line debt
interactionRule: wheel, arrow keys, a directional touch sweep, or read-forward/turn-back controls move the reading window; a one-way pass is refused; Enter or Space commits a deterministic return; Delete lifts the latest; R releases reading
representationRupture: orbital glyph field, pressure slab, and separated word stones -> one continuous browser-native sentence flowing through vertical reading lanes
encounterRupture: approach/depart attention, drag pressure, and pointer path -> reading direction and reversal; the return, not the touch, is causal
temporalRupture: countertype resistance and reciprocal glance debt -> line-break memory that reallocates a place to a distant word
mediumRupture: p5 Canvas atmosphere and inline SVG word cells -> semantic DOM words with CSS writing-mode and browser-native flow
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, interaction evidence, production readback, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
